name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.chatkit.ui.normal.page.ChatBotSubSessionActivity
description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit shows the topic conversations for an AI bot when the app opens that bot's conversation list. Users can search the list, create a topic conversation, and open one.
disableEffect: Users lose access to the AI bot's separate topic conversations and cannot create or open them.
